sources.entry: Mr. Cook - Your AI-Powered Recipe Generator #free

summary.name: Mr. Cook
summary.one_liner: Mr. Cook is an AI recipe generator that builds full recipes with measurements, steps, and nutrition info from typed ingredients, cravings, or a fridge photo.
keywords: what can i cook with what i have
use_cases: Cooking from what is in the fridge
Generating recipes that fit a diet
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a few typed ingredients or a craving and produces a complete recipe with measurements, steps, and nutrition info. Users can snap a photo of their fridge, and the AI identifies what is there and suggests recipes. A diet preference (such as vegan, keto, or allergies) can be set once and applied to every recipe. Each generated recipe is saved automatically and can be organized, shared, or added to a meal plan. The page also describes AI meal plans and automatic shopping lists as part of the paid tier.
notable: Diet settings (vegan, keto, allergies) applied to every recipe
Recipes saved automatically with cross-device sync
Integrated meal planning and auto shopping lists
caveats: Only 3 free AI recipes; unlimited recipes, AI meal plans, and unlimited shopping lists require the Pro tier
Comparison table is the vendor's own claim against unnamed other AI generators
